business_problem: Majid Al Futtaim Retail faced fragmented data systems and slow manual reporting, causing delayed insights and inefficiencies.
solution_summary: Majid Al Futtaim Retail, a Retail organization in United Arab Emirates, modernized this data lake / data warehouse modernization workload with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure, Power BI, Power Apps, and Microsoft Purview. Majid Al Futtaim Retail faced fragmented data systems and slow manual reporting, causing delayed insights and inefficiencies. Azure OpenAI Service runs the large language model workloads that power summarization, generation, or conversational reasoning in the solution. Azure provides the scalable cloud foundation hosting the customer’s modernized applications, data, and AI workloads. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Data from operational systems is ingested into Azure OpenAI Service, processed across Azure, and surfaced through Power BI so teams can act on fresher operational insight. Applies automated information governance before broader AI adoption.

metrics: Majid Al Futtaim (MAF Retail), a leading shopping malls, communities, retail, and leisure pioneer across the Middle East, Africa, and Central Asia, holds exclusive rights to the Carrefour brand in 32 countries. It also operates over 450 stores in 14 nations, employing more than 37,000 people and serving over 770,000 customers daily. Majid Al Futtaim’s flagship stores are especially notable in the Emirates.

Majid Al Futtaim offers a range of 7 million SKUs across its 14 markets, requiring significant commercial and technological effort to manage pricing effectively. The new AI engine, "Spider," ensures competitive pricing by considering various scenarios, recommendations, and periodic promotions, ensuring customers receive the best value and price. Additionally, the engine enhances SKU specifications and information, enabling customers to make better choices and easily navigate their specific needs—whether it’s gluten-free, allergy-friendly, organic, or sustainably packaged.

With over 465 stores and up to 120 legal documents per location, Majid Al Futtaim manages a large volume of contracts using “Excellence.” The team can extract relevant information and map it to financial data for analysis and action. Previously, the legal team spent up to seven working days on each contract inquiry compared to now where they simply search and extract relevant information automatically within minutes.

From seven days to three minutes: Majid Al Futtaim boosts customer centricity with Azure OpenAI Service

By implementing Azure Synapse, Power BI, and Azure OpenAI Service, Majid Al Futtaim Retail centralized data, automated reporting, and integrated advanced AI for better targeting and feedback analysis.
The company saved USD1 million annually, cut feedback processing time from seven days to three hours, and improved geographic targeting, boosting efficiency with AI-driven solutions.
